emails.subject: Update regarding your application at Datadog
emails.snippet: Thank you for your interest in Datadog. While we were impressed with your background, we have decided to move forward with other candidates.
emails.fullBody:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for applying for the Senior Systems Engineer position at Datadog. After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with candidates whose experience more closely matches our immediate needs.

We wish you the best in your job search.
Datadog HR Team

emails.subject: Canva Offer Letter - Staff Platform Engineer
emails.snippet: Dear Alex, We are thrilled to offer you the position of Staff Platform Engineer at Canva in Sydney!
emails.fullBody:
Dear Alex,

On behalf of Canva, we are thrilled to offer you the full-time position of Staff Platform Engineer! Please review the attached official offer details and employment agreement.

Congratulations!
Canva Executive Recruitment

emails.subject: Shopify Take-Home Code Assessment Link
emails.snippet: Hello Alex, As the next step in our evaluation, please complete the technical assessment on HackerRank within 5 days.
emails.fullBody:
Hello Alex,

Thanks for applying to Shopify in Toronto! We would like to move you forward to our technical assessment phase. Please complete the take-home challenge at the following HackerRank link.

Best regards,
Shopify Recruitment Team

emails.subject: Atlassian Technical Interview Invitation - Senior Backend Engineer
emails.snippet: Hi Alex, Thanks for applying! We were very impressed by your Node.js experience. We would love to schedule a 45-minute technical screen next Tuesday.
emails.fullBody:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for applying for the Senior Backend Engineer role at Atlassian in Sydney! Our engineering team reviewed your tailored resume and was very impressed. We would like to invite you to a 45-minute technical video screen.

Please let us know your availability for next Tuesday or Wednesday.

Best regards,
Atlassian Talent Acquisition
